data: What is the value of the blue line at a desired length of 28 on the 'mCIDEr' plot?

The question asks for the value of the blue line at a desired length of 28 on the 'mCIDEr' plot. From the caption, we know that the blue line represents 'LenEmb'. In the figure, the 'mCIDEr' plot is located in the top-left corner. The blue line intersects the y-axis at approximately 190 when the desired length is 28. Therefore, the value of the blue line at a desired length of 28 on the 'mCIDEr' plot is approximately 190.
